title: SvgFeBlend
responsibility: Renders the native feBlend element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeBlend.attributes
inputs.description: Native feBlend attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeBlend.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feBlend element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeBlend
outputs.description: The actual native feBlend element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
